resources.string:
This app only contains the port's own code. To play, you need your own extracted copy of Gears of War 2: the folder that contains default.xex.

Choose that folder and the app copies it into its own storage. The game memory-maps its files and Android cannot memory-map files opened through the folder picker, so the copy needs as much free space as the game takes.

You can also copy the folder yourself, for example over USB from a PC, so that default.xex ends up in:
This device has no folder picker. Copy the game folder over USB instead.
